About CFS

Client File Store (CFS) is a capability of the Data Platform that provides authorization and enables access to content files stored in the publisher-supplied repository. CFS defines content ownership that is publisher isolated. And subscribers can trust the source of the content.

CFS is engineered as a self-service metadata tool intended for publishers and subscribers. CFS provides a bucket and file-set to organize files to simplify the interaction with publishers or subscribers. CFS doesn't store files directly. Actual files are stored in publisher-supplied AWS S3 only one type storage that is supported by the current CFS.
